comment: Pinned third-party programs that release builds bundle (Phase 7 Stage 1). tools/fetch-binaries.ps1 downloads each url into tools/bin/downloads, checks its sha256 (and fails on a mismatch), and copies the files listed in take into app/src-tauri/resources/<dest>, where the shell looks for <dest>/<dest>.exe (sidecar.rs, tool_from). sha256From says where the pinned hash was checked. Bumping a version: change version, url, sha256 (and inner/take if the archive's layout changed), run the script, then the live checks in docs/phases/phase-7-packaging-release.md section 10.

tools.name: mpv
tools.license: GPL-2.0-or-later (mpv; this build links FFmpeg, libass, libplacebo and others as DLLs)
tools.sha256From: GitHub's digest of the release asset (the mpv project publishes no checksum file); matched by the download on 2026-11-17. The build reports itself as v0.41.0-dev-g41f6a6450: 41f6a64 is the v0.41.0 tag's commit

tools.name: ffmpeg
tools.sha256From: gyan.dev's ffmpeg-release-essentials.zip.sha256 (release-version 9.0.2) and GitHub's digest of the release asset, both matched by the download on 2026-11-17

tools.name: yt-dlp
tools.license: Unlicense (yt-dlp); the PyInstaller exe bundles Python (PSF-2.0) and other libraries
tools.sha256From: the release's SHA2-256SUMS and GitHub's digest of the release asset, both matched by the download on 2026-11-17
